zoovet.evidence: Both agents agree, and I confirmed it: zoovet's only Monge Puppy and Junior lamb & rice listing is the 12 kg bag. Its page options are 'Упак (12 кг)' 44000 and 'На развес, 1 кг' 3900. zoovet has no 800 g pack. The other 800 g puppy bags are different lines: Extra Small Puppy & Junior chicken (4250) and Monoprotein Puppy & Junior salmon (4750). Mini Puppy & Junior lamb is a different line and is sold loose or as 15 kg. An EAN search for 8009470011259 found nothing.
